intro: The books: journal entries, credit and debit notes, closing a month and the finance reports. Money paid or received is never deleted; a mistake is reversed, with the reason kept.
start: Check your books in Books and posting: the base currency, the month your year starts, and opening balances from your old records.
Close each month when it is done.

articles.title: Make a credit or debit note
articles.summary: Take something off what a customer or supplier owes, or add to it, with the reason, applied to their invoices.

steps.rest: a customer or a supplier, and the reason, such as goods returned or a price corrected.

steps.rest: then Post and apply once approved. A credit note takes it off what is owed; a debit note adds to it.
